Method of Attack: Downloaded from C2 using wget or curl, saved as /tmp.russ, executed to fetch variants of the Muhstik bot from an IRC server
Supports reception and parsing of shell commands, flood commands, and SSH brute force
Attack Vector: Lua sandbox escape vulnerability in Redis (CVE-2022-0543) exploited remotely via arbitrary Lua scripts
Indicators of Compromise: Proof-of-concept exploit released on GitHub on 2022-03-10
Use of wget or curl to download payload
IRC server communication for bot variants
